opening.title: 開場 / 小聊暖場 7 句

cards.front: Thanks everyone for joining. Let's get started.
cards.back: 感謝大家加入。我們開始吧。(會議開場標準)
cards.hint: get started 比 begin 口語

cards.front: The agenda for today is [topic 1], [topic 2], and [topic 3].
cards.hint: 永遠先說議程

cards.front: How's the weather over there?
cards.back: 你那邊天氣怎麼樣?(跨時區會議小聊)
cards.hint: 最安全 small talk;避政治 / 宗教 / 收入

cards.front: How are things on your end?
cards.back: 你那邊狀況如何?(small talk)
cards.hint: on your end = 你那邊,商務口語

cards.front: Alright, shall we dive into [topic]?
cards.back: 好,我們進入 [主題] 吧?(從 small talk 切換)
cards.hint: dive into = 切換訊號,「閒聊夠了進主題」

cards.front: Before we start, does everyone have the materials I sent?
cards.back: 開始前,大家都有我寄的資料嗎?
cards.hint: 確認對方狀態比直接開講安全

cards.front: Sorry I'm a bit late — I had a conflict.
cards.back: 抱歉我遲到一下 — 我有事撞期。
cards.hint: conflict = 行程衝突(會議用語)

cards.front: I'd like to suggest [proposal].
cards.back: 我想提議 [方案]。
cards.hint: 模板級;比 Let's do X 客氣

cards.front: What if we [verb] ...?
cards.back: 如果我們 [動作] 會怎麼樣?(試探起手)
cards.hint: 疑問句不會被批駁;會議高頻技巧

cards.front: In my view, [statement].
cards.back: 依我看,[論點]。(確定意見)
cards.hint: view 比 opinion 在會議更正式

cards.front: I'd lean toward [option A] rather than [option B].
cards.back: 我會偏向 [A] 而不是 [B]。(緩和意見)
cards.hint: lean toward = 比較傾向,給對方空間反駁

cards.front: Building on what [Name] said, ...
cards.back: 延續 [某人] 剛說的,...
cards.hint: Building on = 在這基礎上,團隊合作感

cards.front: I would strongly recommend [option].
cards.back: 我強烈推薦 [選項]。(高份量提案)
cards.hint: 比 strongly suggest 在商務更有份量

cards.front: Based on the data, [conclusion].
cards.back: 根據數據,[結論]。
cards.hint: 英文最有力的開頭之一;反對你的人也要拿數據反

agreeing.title: 同意與委婉反對 7 句

cards.front: I'm fully on board with that.
cards.back: 我完全同意。(完全同意)
cards.hint: on board = 上船 / 加入,商務用語

cards.front: I agree with the general direction, but I'd push back on [point].
cards.back: 大方向我同意,但 [某點] 我會反對。(部分同意)
cards.hint: push back on = 反推;先同意再反對特定點

cards.front: I see your point, but have we considered [alternative]?
cards.back: 我懂你的意思,但我們有考慮過 [替代] 嗎?(委婉反對)
cards.hint: I see your point ≠ I agree;給對方台階

cards.front: I'd respectfully disagree.
cards.back: 我會恭敬地不同意。(中等反對)
cards.hint: 給上司 / 客戶用的正式禮貌反對

cards.front: One concern I have is [issue].
cards.back: 我有一個顧慮是 [問題]。(提風險)
cards.hint: 中性表達不同意,不會吵架

cards.front: Let's not [verb] just yet — let me look into [alternative] first.
cards.back: 先不要 [動作] — 讓我先研究 [替代]。
cards.hint: just yet = 暫時還不,保留未來可能

cards.front: I don't think that's the right path for us.
cards.back: 我不認為那是適合我們的方向。(強烈反對)
cards.hint: Not the right path 比 That's wrong 軟,但意思一樣強

cards.front: Could you repeat that, please?
cards.back: 可以請你再說一次嗎?(基本款)
cards.hint: 1 場會議最多用 1-2 次,多了顯跟不上

cards.front: Sorry, could you clarify what you mean by [term]?
cards.back: 不好意思,你說的 [詞] 是什麼意思?
cards.hint: 顯示你大致懂,只是確認某詞 — 比 I don't understand 顯專業

cards.front: Let me see if I understand correctly — you're saying [your understanding]?
cards.back: 我看我有沒有理解對 — 你的意思是 [我的理解]?
cards.hint: 金句!顯示你有聽 + 想對齊;會議專家常用

cards.front: Could we slow down for a moment?
cards.back: 我們可以慢一點嗎?
cards.hint: we 而不是 you;把責任變共同的

cards.front: Could you elaborate on [specific point]?
cards.back: 你能多說一點關於 [某點] 嗎?
cards.hint: elaborate on = 細說;顯示有興趣

cards.front: So just to confirm, the next step is [action]?
cards.back: 那我確認一下,下一步是 [動作]?
cards.hint: Just to confirm = 整理共識,避免散會各自記不同

cards.front: Today I'll walk you through [topic].
cards.back: 今天我會帶你看過 [主題]。(簡報開場)
cards.hint: walk you through = 帶你走過;比 explain 溫暖

cards.front: I have three main points to cover.
cards.back: 我有三個主要重點要講。
cards.hint: 永遠先說多少點,給觀眾 mental map

cards.front: Let's start with [first point].
cards.back: 讓我們從 [第一點] 開始。
cards.hint: 簡報開頭過渡

cards.front: Moving on to [next point], ...
cards.back: 接著到 [下一點],...
cards.hint: 最標準轉場詞

cards.front: The key takeaway here is [insight].
cards.back: 這裡的重點是 [洞察]。
cards.hint: key takeaway = 觀眾會記筆記的黃金句

cards.front: As you can see from the chart, [insight].
cards.back: 從圖表你可以看到,[洞察]。
cards.hint: 引導觀眾看視覺資料的固定句

cards.front: To summarize, we've covered [point 1], [point 2], and [point 3].
cards.hint: 結尾標配

cards.front: The next step is [action], and I'd love your support on this.
cards.back: 下一步是 [行動],我希望能得到大家的支持。(CTA)
cards.hint: I'd love your support 比 Please support 軟而有效

interruption.title: 處理打斷 / 控場 7 句

cards.front: Sorry to interrupt — could I add a quick thought?
cards.back: 抱歉打斷 — 我可以加一個快速想法嗎?(禮貌打斷)
cards.hint: Sorry to interrupt 是必備緩衝

cards.front: Let me finish this thought, then I'll come back to you.
cards.back: 讓我把這想法講完,我會回到你的問題。
cards.hint: 金句!既擋下又承諾不忽視對方

cards.front: Hold that thought for a moment.
cards.back: 那想法先記住。
cards.hint: Hold that thought 禮貌但堅定

cards.front: [Name], what's your take on this?
cards.back: [某人],你的看法是?(引導發言權)
cards.hint: what's your take 比 what do you think 更口語

cards.front: Let's circle back to the main topic.
cards.back: 我們繞回主題吧。
cards.hint: circle back to = 繞回,比 back to the topic 更專業

cards.front: We're running short on time. Let's prioritize [topic].
cards.back: 時間不夠了。我們優先處理 [主題]。
cards.hint: running short on time = 時間越來越緊

cards.front: Let's table this for next meeting.
cards.back: 這事項先擱到下次會議。
cards.hint: 美式 table = 暫緩 / 移後(英式相反!跨國會議用美式)

closing.title: 結束會議 / 行動項 8 句

cards.front: In the interest of time, let's wrap up.
cards.back: 考慮時間,我們收尾吧。
cards.hint: In the interest of time 比 time's up 專業

cards.front: To recap, we've agreed on [decisions].
cards.back: 總結,我們達成 [決定]。
cards.hint: recap 比 summarize 在會議結尾更自然

cards.front: Action items: [Name] will [task] by [deadline].
cards.back: 行動項:[某人] 將在 [截止日] 前 [任務]。
cards.hint: 標配:具體到誰 / 做什麼 / 何時

cards.front: Any final questions or comments?
cards.back: 還有最後的問題或評論嗎?
cards.hint: final 暗示「就快結束了」

cards.front: I'll send out the minutes by EOD.
cards.back: 我會在今天結束前寄出會議紀錄。
cards.hint: EOD = end of day;EOW = end of week

cards.front: Thanks everyone for your time. Have a great rest of the day.
cards.back: 感謝大家的時間。祝大家有美好的下半天。
cards.hint: 美式商務友善結尾

cards.front: Let's reconvene next week to follow up.
cards.back: 我們下週重開會跟進。
cards.hint: reconvene = 重新召集,正式但口語也通

cards.front: Cool, let's call it.
cards.back: 好,就到這。(隨意收尾)
cards.hint: 美式內部會議超口語;給上司用會太隨意
